own: Just because a trade is on hold does not mean their account is on hold, so of course they can reach out to moderators and fill them in on new information. But even on trades that are on hold, they can still go into the trade and still message back and forth and add more context to the trade. It's just no currency is going to be moving back and forth until the moderator decides. So that trade they can still access, they can still message back and forth with the other person because all that context is going to help the moderator.
question: During someone's account hold, can their trade partner still open a dispute?
